# evroc_kms_key (Resource)

Manages a KMS-generated encryption key in the provider region. Destroy schedules deletion and returns once acknowledged; the API retains the key during its deletion grace period. Immutable settings require replacement with a different name while the old key is pending deletion. Key material is never returned or stored in Terraform state. Terraform import adopts an existing key; it does not upload key material. Material import, manual rotation/trimming, and cancelling deletion use separate SDK operations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "evroc_kms_key" "application" {
  name                   = "application-key"
  auto_rotate_after_days = 30
  expire_after_days      = 365
  enabled                = true

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Key name, unique within the project and region. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Optional

- `algorithm` (String) Encryption algorithm. Defaults to aes256-gcm96, the only supported algorithm. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `auto_rotate_after_days` (Number) Days between automatic rotations. Omit when creating the key to disable automatic rotation. Must be at least 1 when set. Immutable. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Activate the key when true (the default); suspend it when false.
- `expire_after_days` (Number) Days before key versions expire. Omit when creating the key for no automatic expiry. Must be at least 1 when set. Immutable. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `project` (String) Project containing the key. Defaults to the provider project. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC3339 format.
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified key identifier.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `imported` (Boolean) Whether key material was imported externally. This resource creates KMS-generated keys; existing imported keys may be adopted after material import.
- `key_id` (String) System-assigned UUID.
- `region` (String) Region selected by the provider configuration.
- `state` (String) Observed KMS lifecycle state.
- `versions` (List of Object) Observed key versions; does not contain key material. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Configure the provider for the key's project and region first.
terraform import evroc_kms_key.application application-key
```
